usage: tf [-h] {setup,status,assign,beta,notes,upload} ...

TestFlight without an Apple ID session: upload, status, assign, beta, notes,
setup. Credentials come from the env file (default ~/.appstoreconnect/heinzel-
mini.env, override with ASC_ENV_FILE): ASC_KEY_ID, ASC_ISSUER_ID,
ASC_KEY_PATH. The key file is never read for display; it only signs the JWT.

positional arguments:
  {setup,status,assign,beta,notes,upload}
    setup               enable automatic distribution on the internal group
    beta                print a build's internal beta state
    notes               set a build's What to Test text from a file
    upload              export and upload an .xcarchive

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
